clue: Nice loses leader, after monarch leaves while invoking bill
explanation: INVOICE: bill. ICE (NICE loses leader). INVO (KING leaves while INVOKING). ICE after INVO = INVOICE.
hints: What letters do you get if NICE loses leader?
We need a word for a monarch.
The word for monarch is going to "leave while" INVOKING. Get rid of it!
What do you get if you put ICE after INVO? Then you've found your answer!
